title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Alert Reset: Period for the Alert Daily Cost
content:
For the reset of a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) low-balance alert amount, the period over which the alert daily cost is averaged follows how long the enrollment has been active, counted in whole months from its activation date to the current date.

**Rule.** Where the enrollment was activated fewer than two whole months before the current date, the alert daily cost is the total of all of its daily charge lines since the activation divided by the number of service days since the activation; where it was activated at least six whole months before the current date, the alert daily cost is the total of its daily charge lines in the three-month window divided by the service days in that window; an enrollment in any other situation keeps the one-month figure.

A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date. The service days are the days the daily charge lines cover.

| Whole months since activation | Alert daily cost |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | all daily charge lines since activation, divided by the service days since activation |
| 2 to 5 | keeps the one-month figure |
| 6 or more | daily charge lines of the three-month window, divided by the service days in that window |

Hypothetical enrollments: activated 40 days ago (one whole month), with 212.00 of daily charge lines over 40 service days: 5.30 a day. Activated seven whole months ago, with 460.00 over 92 service days in the three-month window: 5.00 a day. Activated exactly two whole months ago: the one-month figure stands.
